confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Belgrade price levels for July 2026. No live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the firmest. Accommodation is less certain, and July is peak season. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of bar prices is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Belgrade is priced like other mid-sized Central and Southeast European capitals, such as Sofia and Bucharest, which are cheaper than Western European capitals.
